children: Research Solutions reported fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year results for the period ended June 30, 2026, recording a record full-year net income of $2.8 million and annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $22.5 million. Total fiscal 2026 revenue was $48.3 million with gross profit of $25.1 million and improved gross margin to 51.9%. The company noted B2B ARR grew 14.1% year-over-year to $16.2 million and Adjusted EBITDA reached a company record $5.8 million for the year.
Total revenue: $48.3 million for fiscal 2026 (compared to $49.1 million in fiscal 2025); Q4 revenue $12.1 million (vs. $12.4 million prior-year quarter).

Gross profit: $25.1 million for fiscal 2026; total gross margin 51.9% (up 260 basis points year-over-year). Q4 gross profit $6.4 million; Q4 gross margin 53.0% (up 200 basis points vs. prior-year quarter).
Operating income (income from operations): $3.588 million for fiscal 2026; Q4 operating income $842,375.
Net income: $2.822 million for fiscal 2026, or $0.09 per diluted share; Q4 net income $665,556, or $0.02 per diluted share.
Adjusted EBITDA: $5.826 million for fiscal 2026 (company record); Q4 Adjusted EBITDA $1.430 million.
ARR and segment mix: Total ARR of $22.5 million at quarter end, comprising $16.2 million B2B recurring revenue and $6.3 million B2C recurring revenue; B2B ARR rose 14.1% year-over-year.
Platform momentum: Platform revenue increased to $20.8 million for the year (43% of total revenue, up from 39%), supporting margin expansion driven by higher-margin Platforms business.

AI product launches: Multiple new AI-based products launched in FY26, including Scite MCP and Article Galaxy MCP integrations enabling use within ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other AI tools; company reported AI-related ARR of $0.8 million and sequential AI ARR growth.

Deployments and customer activity: Added 105 net new B2B platform deployments in fiscal 2026, ending the quarter with 1,276 platform deployments; transaction active customer count was 1,323 in the quarter.
Operational cash & balance sheet: Cash and cash equivalents of $12.6 million at year end and operating cash flow of $5.3 million for fiscal 2026, reflecting timing of working capital payments.
